en: Let's keep heading forward.
Villager: This is Lord Zhou's hometown. I heard a great treasure of the demonkind is hidden in this village, so I came a long way to find it. Sigh, and I still haven't found it!
Villager: A few days ago Lord Zhou's spirit appeared and warned that a bloody disaster will soon strike Nanbei Village.
Villager: Lord Zhou's spirit said three outsiders, one man and two women, would come to the village, and only they could avert the disaster.
One man and two women?
Villager: Hey, one man and two women - that's you! Lord Zhou is never wrong!
Villager: Lord Zhou is never wrong!
Villager A: Lord Zhou's spirit appeared and said a bloody disaster is coming.
Villager B: I'm not scared. If you've done nothing wrong, you don't fear a knock at the door at midnight.
Villager A: Where did that reek wind just now come from? It stank something awful.
Villager B: Tell me about it! Two people at the village gate got knocked out by it, and they're still unconscious!
That damn White Tiger, @@$%@#$%#%@#@#@#@#!!!
Villager A: What a world we live in... sigh...
Excuse me, how are the unconscious villagers doing?
Villager A: Still haven't woken up. I fear the worst.
I've got two pills here. Give them these and their lives will be saved.
Villager B: You're such good people!
Villager B: They say Fengdu is a city of ghosts. I wonder if it's true.
You don't have that item.
Let's look around first.
We haven't gotten Zhou Chu's big reward yet. Leaving now would be a waste...
Cancel
Use Picklock
You have no key.
This was once a great treasure of the Demon Realm. It was lost to the mortal world during the War of Gods and Demons.
How do you know so much about it?
I... uh... well...
Sister Yuan knows so many things, no wonder she can't remember where she heard them all.
Zhou Chu: I have been waiting for you three for some time.
So it's Zhou Chu.

Zhou Chu: My recent divinations show that the South Hill White Tiger and the North Sea Blue Dragon, whom I slew long ago, are stirring back to life. But this time is different: my readings are muddled, as if something is interfering.
Zhou Chu: I'd like you to find out what is going on. You will be richly rewarded.
Zhou Chu: I trust you three have already dealt with the White Tiger.
Hmph, you never say anything straight. Yes, the White Tiger's done for. But two villagers got knocked out by its reek wind - what are you going to do about that?
Zhou Chu: Ah, I have two Bliss Pills here. Give them to those two quickly, or not only will they die, a plague may break out.
That's more like it.
Zhou Chu: The Blue Dragon's Blood Rain plagues the world just like the White Tiger's reek wind. You must destroy it quickly.
Zhou Chu: You three kept your word. I thank you on behalf of all living things.
Just thanks? Weren't you promising a big reward?
Zhou Chu: I have a book here. Please take it.
Times aren't very peaceful lately. Best to carry a weapon.
Times are hard. I've got no choice but to sell cheap.
I gather all my herbs myself. Quality guaranteed.
Passerby: Whoa, who are you? Never seen you before. Are you people or ghosts?
What a weird guy. Ghosts, in broad daylight?
Passerby: Don't scare a guy like that, you'll scare me to death! These days nobody dares say even half the word 'ghost', even in broad daylight.
Passerby: I don't get it. I never go out at night, so how come I see them in the daytime too? I never did anything to offend them...
Passerby: I wonder if the one I saw yesterday was my great-grandfather who died ages ago. I'd better go burn incense for him tomorrow.
Passerby A: I got scared again yesterday at noon. Now my nerves are shot.
Passerby B: Sigh, my wife went out for groceries yesterday afternoon and fainted from fright. She still can't get out of bed! What a curse...
Whoa, what's that in the well? Something's glinting down there.
My weapons are all top-notch. Come, have a look.
Innkeeper: Will you be dining or staying the night, sir?
No thanks, it's still early.
Innkeeper, may I ask why everyone here looks like they've seen a ghost?
Innkeeper: You've hit the nail on the head, sir. They really were scared by ghosts.
Oh...

Innkeeper: You wouldn't know, sir - this is Fengdu, the ghost city. Here no one walks the streets at night: the living own the day, the ghosts own the night. But lately some ghosts come out by day and give people terrible frights.
Oh, really? Innkeeper, we'll stay here tonight.
After dark...
Innkeeper: Where are you going, sir?
Just taking a look around.
Innkeeper: Please don't go out, sir! Nothing out there right now is human. I won't even open my front door.
Don't worry, we're just going to catch up with some old friends.
Cancel
Use Picklock
You have no key.
My medicines work for everyone - people, ghosts and gods alike.
A pawnshop needn't be big, but it must be fair.
Got lots of new stock lately. Have a look even if you don't buy.
The yin energy here is strong. Let's find the Ghost King - he's bound to know...
Bai Wuchang: You're living people? Don't you know the rules here?
We want to see the Ghost King.
Bai Wuchang: Oh, hee hee, ha ha! If you want to see the Ghost King, you have to die first.
We have to see the Ghost King!
Well? Take us to see the Ghost King.

Bai Wuchang: If my brother Hei Wuchang weren't away on business, you'd never have won. We'll have a rematch someday! The Ghost King is at the City God Temple in the south of town. I'm not coming - the old man's had a foul temper lately.
Bai Wuchang: Then I'll grant your wish.

Ghost King: The yin energy has grown far too strong, all because the demons of the world have come back to life. They keep harassing the ghostkind, so the spirits get no rest and roam about even in broad daylight.
I am from Sanqing Hall...
Ghost King: Sanqing Hall! Perfect timing.
Ghost King: You're the better fighter. Kill me if you like.
We really didn't come here looking for trouble.
Ghost King: Spare me the act. The ghostkind will never bow to Patriarch Tiandao.
I think you've misunderstood. We came looking for the Tyrant Bell we lost a few days ago, not to make you surrender.
Ghost King: That bell is called the Tyrant Bell? It's yours?
Yes. It was stolen by the demonkind.
Ghost King: So you're not Tiandao's people.
I'm from Sanqing Hall. Have you seen the bell?

Ghost King: The demonkind keep harassing us. Their monsters left word: within three days the ghostkind must bow to Patriarch Tiandao, or be wiped out. Tiandao heads the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice, and my rage at him makes me hate every Taoist alive. The monsters carry a bell of boundless power: any ghost trapped under it melts into a pool of blood, body and soul destroyed. We lose every battle - even our vanguard generals Ox-Head and Horse-Face are gone. That must be your Tyrant Bell.
The monsters who stole the bell are tied to Tiandao...
Ghost King: You lost the bell, so I hope you'll settle this. Tiandao is on Mt. Heming. Leave Fengdu heading west and keep going, and you'll get there.
Ghost King: I swore that any Taoist I meet dies!
We didn't come here looking for trouble.
Ghost King: Enough talk. Have at you...
Whoa, what a stench @#$!#
I think I'm going to be sick.
The White Tiger must be nearby. Let's search carefully.
Tiger Thrall: Hey, kid, barging into our cave like that - you know that means death!
Oh, really? Let's find out.
Tiger Thrall: You don't know what's good for you... Boys, get him!
Tiger Thrall: Not bad. No wonder the boss is wary of you.
Huh! Why is nobody here?
Let's search carefully. We can't let it get away again.
White Tiger: Shit, I turned into a bunch of haystacks and STILL couldn't fool you!!!
White Tiger: The hills stay green and the rivers keep flowing - until we meet again!
Whoa, what a massive stink...
White Tiger: Come on, let's settle this with kung fu.
White Tiger: Hmph, you only got me because you came while I was still training my Reek Wind art. If I'd mastered it, you'd never have lasted this long.
Why is the water blood-red everywhere? Not a sign of life - it's as if time has stopped here.
This place is so creepy!
Kung fu this lame, and you call yourselves dragons?
What a weird-looking lizard! !$#@$%!!
North Sea Wyrm: You just wait, I'll !@#$!#!$#!@@#$!
What a cute little puppy!
North Sea Drake: You remember this, I won't @#$!#!$#!@@#$!
North Sea Wyrm: What? You dare call me, the North Sea Wyrm, a lizard? Oh, you and I are going to have words about this...
Ooh, I'm so scared...
North Sea Wyrm: Hmph, scared now? Too late. I'm going to cut out your tongue.
I'm just scared you're too big for us to finish eating, haha...
North Sea Wyrm: Argh, you're driving me mad!
North Sea Wyrm: What? Calling my brother Drake a dog I could let slide, but now you insult me too? You're asking to die.
Sigh, another one. What a pain...
North Sea Wyrm: Now you know how tough I am.
Sigh, looks like we really can't finish eating you.
North Sea Wyrm: !@#$!#$!@#$!@#$
North Sea Drake: What? You dare call me, the North Sea Drake, a puppy? Oh, you and I are going to have words about this...
Ooh, I'm so scared...
North Sea Drake: Hmph, scared now? Too late. I'm going to cut out your tongue.
I'm just scared you're too big for us to finish eating, haha...
North Sea Drake: Argh, you're driving me mad!
North Sea Drake: What? Calling my brother Wyrm a lizard I could let slide, but you dare call me a dog? You're asking to die.
Sigh, another one. What a pain...
North Sea Drake: No one who insults me, human or demon, has ever come to a good end.
Then let's see whose kung fu is tougher!
North Sea Wyrm: You only beat us because we were split up. That doesn't count!
North Sea Drake: Now we'll take you on together.
Bring it on!
Blue Dragon: Hahahaha... I didn't misjudge you. Anyone who can beat the White Tiger shouldn't lose to my Wyrm Guard and Drake Guard. But you'll never defeat me. Have a taste of my Blood Rain!
Finally, someone worth fighting.
Blue Dragon: Not bad at all. Too bad you can't beat me.
Is this a village? Why is it so desolate...
What are we waiting for? Straight up the mountain!
Villager A: Those monsters come every few days. Next time it might be us lying on the ground.
Villager B: Sigh, Heaven has no eyes...
The demonkind have gone too far.
Let's fight our way up the mountain!
Right!
Villager: What do we do, what do we do? Those monsters are sure to...
Villager: We're doomed. Better run...
We can't turn back now.
Let's get into the cave first.
I'll kill every last one of you demons... kill...
Who dares barge onto Mt. Heming?
Kill... kill... kill...
Tiandao: If I can't rule the Three Realms of demons, gods and men, then no one else will either.
Tiandao: Haha... hahaha...
Tiandao laughs long and loud, then dies.
Ah, what... what's going... on?

Red Phoenix (Yuan Pingzhi): In Nanbei Village, Zhou Chu showed me how to turn from evil. Seeing how strong the demonkind had grown and the misery they caused, I had long wanted to turn back. I just feared you couldn't accept the truth, so I never found the chance to tell you. Now that it's all out in the open, I actually feel at peace.
How... can this... be???

Red Phoenix: I was one of the Star Lords of the Four Symbols. I gave in to my inner demon and trained the demonic art Fireplume Demonform, and as Heaven's punishment Perfected Xuanxu sealed me in Demon Cave on Sanqing's back mountain. While sealed I wanted to turn to good, but Wuji offered to break my seal, and I gave in again. For him I set up the Four Symbols Godslayer Array, to stop anyone climbing the mountain to disturb his demonic arts.
Ah... Master...

Red Phoenix: The monsters at Heartsease and the demons who raided Mt. Zhong were all Wuji's doing. But the demons' revival was Liu Qingfeng's own work. Wuji had trained his demonic arts, the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis, to the 7th level, and found he needed the fury of the world's suffering to go further. He was already seven-tenths demon; had he broken the seals in Demon Cave himself, the Primal Demonbane Array would have destroyed him body and soul. So he used Liu Qingfeng to free the demons.
It was him...

Red Phoenix: Wuji put me at Liu Qingfeng's side to get rid of him once he had killed Tiandao. The demons that raided Mt. Zhong were Tiandao's men. Tiandao knew Wuji's plan, but he had long coveted the Tyrant Bell, and with Wuji not stepping in, it was the chance of a lifetime. Tiandao also knew my mission, so even in death he forced out my true form to ruin Wuji's scheme. But he never expected the Tyrant Bell to fail against Liu Qingfeng - still less that Zhou Chu would change my heart...
No... it can't be...

Red Phoenix: You must reach Sanqing Hall within three days and destroy Wuji. Once he masters the tenth level of the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis, not even the highest immortals can stop him. At the tenth level he can turn anything into a demon, and the demons he makes cannot die. Now that I've seen the light, I have no regrets!!

Red Phoenix: The Chaos Urn sits inside the Four Symbols Godslayer Array. The souls of the Four Symbols that built it were drawn into the Urn to control the array. Return the four souls to their places and the array will fail. You still need the Turtle Orb - sadly I can't go with you to find it. Even out of control, the Urn can drain the soul of anyone who enters, so you'll need the Heaven Lamp to protect you.
Red Phoenix: I have a move called "Dragon Cloud Grab". I hope it serves you well.
The Red Phoenix takes her own life.
Yuan...
How could this happen...
The sound of a demon horde draws near.
Brother Liu, it sounds like a whole horde of demons is coming this way. We'd better hide first.
Wha... what...? There's a cave over there. Get inside first...
Murong Xiaomei joins the party.
So you're Tiandao?
Tiandao: That's me, boy. So you've finally come!
Tiandao, you've led the demons to ravage the world. Today I'll do Heaven's justice...

Tiandao: Boy, you're nothing but Wuji's pawn. He's the real archfiend menacing the world. The demons' revival and their cruelty are all Wuji's doing - I just rode the wave. I can see you've got talent. How about it? Join me. At least I'm more upfront than Wuji.
Damn you! You've fallen to the demonic path and now you slander my master? Today I'll kill you for sure...
Lies, it's all lies...
Red Phoenix: Listen to me...
Lies...
Red Phoenix: Liu Qingfeng, you're the only one who can stop Wuji...
Ding!
Dang!
Dong!
Clang!
Sounds like stone breaking over there.
Dark Turtle: Whoever invades this tomb dies.
Dark Turtle: Heh heh, now you know how tough I am!
You're the Dark Turtle? Then you've got the Turtle Orb, right?
Dark Turtle: Oh? That depends on what you can do.
Cancel
Use Picklock
You have no key.
The last few characters are really strange.
Look closely!
Hello there, old grandpa...
Who are you, really?
Sage Spirit: I am a fragment of Zhang Daoling's soul. I still clung to the world, so I could not ascend. Today you have set me free.
If you're the Celestial Master's soul, then you must know what kind of man my master Wuji is?
Sage Spirit: What a misfortune for the Taoist order, to produce two depraved archfiends like Tiandao and Wuji...
Master really has become a demon... how could... this...
Liu Qingfeng faints.
Where am I?

We're near Heartsease. The Celestial Master's soul sent us here as he ascended - you were out cold. He said you must get rid of Wuji fast, or once he turns demon, the world will face a disaster like never before.
Then let's go.
Who disturbs my meditation again? If I can't reach enlightenment, you're not getting away either...
Who are you, anyway?
I'm your granddaddy!
